meanEn.text: a republic in southwestern Europe on the Iberian Peninsula; Portuguese explorers and colonists in the 15th and 16th centuries created a vast overseas empire (including Brazil)

448127.mnemonic: "Portugal"最常见的含义是“葡萄牙”，例如："She visited Portugal last summer." (她去年夏天去了葡萄牙)。你还可以说"the culture of Portugal"（葡萄牙的文化），"Portugal's capital"（葡萄牙的首都），"Portugal's history"（葡萄牙的历史），还有"Portugal's climate"（葡萄牙的气候）噢～🍷

sentence.en: The color of the national flag of Portugal is mainly red and green.
sentence.cn: 葡萄牙国旗的颜色主要是红色和绿色。

similars.mean: 轻便的，手提的，便携式的
